build_attention_module: build a self-attention module with configurable heads, dropout, and QKV bias for transformer blocks
build_mem_eff_attention: build a memory-efficient attention module using xFormers for reduced VRAM during training
build_flash_attention: build a flash attention module that auto-selects SDPA backend based on tensor dtype
build_cross_attention_rope: build a cross-attention module with separate QKV projections, QK normalization, and RoPE support
get_attn_score: get the attention score matrix from a transformer block for visualization or analysis
